title: New tutorial video available for Genetic Loci Clustering
summary: A new tutorial video explains how to navigate the Genetic Loci Clustering interface.
bodyHtml: Thanks to Hyungkyung Kim of the Broad Institute, we have a new tutorial video to explain an interface that lets you explore clusters of genetic association signals for cardiometabolic diseases, which potentially reveal disease mechanistic pathways. Access the interface by selecting "Genetic Loci Clustering" in the KP Labs menu in the upper menu bar. Clustering results generated by Hyungkyung Kim and Miriam Udler are displayed along with epigenomic enrichment analysis from Joshua Chiou and Kyle Gaulton.
